an3.141:1.1: Tayo ca bhikkhave assasadasse desessāmi tayo ca purisasadasse.
an3.141:1.2: Taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasikarotha bhāsissāmī ti.
an3.141:1.3: Evaṃ bhante ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an3.141:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco assasadasso javasampanno hoti na vaṇṇasampanno na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
an3.141:2.3: Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco assasadasso javasampanno hoti vaṇṇasampanno na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
an3.141:2.4: Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco assasadasso javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
an3.141:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco purisasadasso javasampanno hoti na vaṇṇasampanno na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
an3.141:3.3: Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco purisasadasso javasampanno hoti vaṇṇasampanno na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
an3.141:3.4: Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco purisasadasso javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca. 3.
an3.141:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave purisasadasso javasampanno hoti na vaṇṇasampanno na ārohapariṇāhasampanno?
an3.141:4.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha-parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
an3.141:4.4: Abhidhamme kho pana abhivinaye pañhaṃ puṭṭho saṃsādeti no vissajjeti.
an3.141:4.7: Idam assa na ārohapariṇāhasmiṃ vadāmi. Evaṃ kho bhikkhave purisasadasso javasampanno hoti
an3.141:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave [bhikkhu] purisasadasso javasampanno hoti vaṇṇasampanno na ārohapariṇāhasampanno?
an3.141:5.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tatha-parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
an3.141:5.4: Abhidhamme kho pana abhivinaye pañhaṃ puṭṭho vissajjeti no saṃsādeti.
an3.141:5.6: Na kho pana lābhī hoti cīvara . . . parikkhā<rā>naṃ.
an3.141:5.8: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave purisasadasso javasampanno hoti vaṇṇasampanno na ārohapariṇāhasampanno. 5.
an3.141:6.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave purisasadasso javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca?
an3.141:6.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ . . . pe . . . anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
an3.141:6.4: Abhidhamme kho pana abhivinaye pañhaṃ puṭṭho vissajjeti no saṃsādeti.
an3.141:6.6: Lābhī kho pana hoti cīvara . . . parikkhā<rā>naṃ.
an3.141:6.8: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave purisasadasso javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
